title: Patch: the C module's `log` export traps every `f64::ln`
thread:
**Issue #4273 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4273: Patch: the C module's `log` export traps every `f64::ln`
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of #2898. Found while replaying golden seeds through `crates/wasm/c` from a host outside JavaScript.

## The bug

- **The clash.** The C module's `#[no_mangle]` export `log` (#3108, the game log) has the same symbol name as libm's `log`, which `f64::ln` lowers to on `wasm32-unknown-unknown`.
- **What the linker does.** `cargo build -p jackioh-wasm-c --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown` warns `rust-lld: function signature mismatch: log`. It resolves the clash with a trapping stub, `signature_mismatch:log`, which shows in the module's name section.
- **What breaks.** Every `ln` in the module traps with `unreachable` and leaves no panic text. That covers `jackioh-shared`'s glicko2 (`ranked/glicko2.rs`, reached by `ranked`'s `rateGame`) and the ladder bots' `bots/think.rs` and `bots/signals.rs`.
- **To reproduce:** through the C module, call `ranked` with `planSeason`, then `rateGame` for two sides. It traps, and the instance is dead.
- **What it doesn't touch.** The rules engine's `reduce` path calls no `ln`, so games, the golden replay and the fuzz are unaffected.

## What to do

- Rename the C export (`game_log`, say). `crates/wasm/tests/export_parity.rs` holds the C module's export list to the browser module's, so rename the browser binding with it, and update its callers and `crates/wasm/README.md`/`crates/wasm/c/README.md`.
- Check whether the browser module's `log` clashes the same way (its build's linker warnings, and its name section).
- Add a test that would have caught it, either or both:
  - the C module's build check (`scripts/build-wasm.sh`, beside the import check) fails on any `signature_mismatch:` name in the built module;
  - a C-module test calls `ranked` `rateGame` and expects status 0.

## Done when

- The module builds with no `signature mismatch` warning.
- `ranked` `rateGame` answers through the C module.
- The new check fails on the old code.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44603220429)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Rename the C module's `#[no_mangle]` export `log` to `game_log` (and the browser module's `log` binding with it, which `export_parity.rs` requires), because the symbol collides with libm's `log` on `wasm32-unknown-unknown` and every `f64::ln` in the module traps. Add a build-time gate in `scripts/build-wasm.sh` that fails the C-module build on any `signature_mismatch:` stub, and confirm `ranked` `rateGame` answers through the rebuilt C module.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scripts/build-wasm.sh` | change | C-module section: after the import check, fail the build when the built `jackioh_wasm_c.wasm` contains `signature_mismatch:` |
| `crates/wasm/c/src/lib.rs` | change | `pub extern "C" fn log` → `game_log` (before `host`, ~line 809); `arg("log: the call", …)` → `arg("game_log: the call", …)`; doc comment unchanged |
| `crates/wasm/src/lib.rs` | change | `#[wasm_bindgen] pub fn log` → `game_log` (~line 426); doc comment unchanged |
| `crates/wasm/c/src/tests.rs` | change | `log_export_answers_what_the_core_body_answers` → `game_log_export_answers_what_the_core_body_answers`; its two `call!(log; …)` sites → `call!(game_log; …)`; `wasm_core::log` calls unchanged |
| `apps/web/src/wasm/index.ts` | change | `export function log` → `gameLog`; body `normal.log(` → `normal.game_log(`, label `call("log",` → `call("gameLog",` (~line 732) |
| `apps/web/src/game/logLines.ts` | change | `import { log }` → `import { gameLog }`; the two call sites in `logLines` and `gapLine` |
| `apps/web/src/wasm/index.test.ts` | change | WRAPPERS entry `["log", (w) => w.log(ANY)]` → `["gameLog", (w) => w.gameLog(ANY)]` (~line 140) |
| `crates/wasm/README.md` | change | Bindings table row 34: `` `log(call)` `` → `` `game_log(call)` `` and `binds it as `log(call_ptr, call_len)`` → `` `game_log(call_ptr, call_len)` `` |
| `crates/wasm/c/README.md` | change | Bindings table row 142: `` `log(call)` `` → `` `game_log(call)` `` |
| `docs/v0.3.0/SURFACE.md` | change | §10.1 line 823 `pub fn log(call_json` → `pub fn game_log(call_json`; §10.3 line 854 `` `log` (#3108 …) `` → `` `game_log` (#3108 …) `` |

Do not touch: `crates/wasm/core/src/lib.rs` (its `pub fn log` is an internal mangled symbol, no clash), anything under `crates/shared/`, `crates/engine/`, `crates/cards/`, `crates/ai/`, `crates/server/`, generated `apps/web/src/wire/`, `apps/web/src/game/contract.ts` (`log: "log"` is a DOM test-id), art recipes (`part: "log"`), audio test fakes, or anything under `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`. Governing spec: SPEC §9.12 (ranked ladder, R603–R612) for the `rateGame` repro; SPEC §10.10 with R97/R745 for the game log (name change only, no behavior change). No new ruling note: this fixes a symbol collision, it settles no rules question.

## Steps

1. Reproduce and scope (read-only, no edits). Build the C module capturing stderr: `JACKIOH_WASM_C=1 JACKIOH_WASM_NORMAL=0 sh scripts/build-wasm.sh 2>/tmp/c-wasm-build.log; grep -i 'signature mismatch' /tmp/c-wasm-build.log`. Confirm the stub bytes: `grep -ac 'signature_mismatch:' target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/jackioh_wasm_c.wasm`. Then check the browser side the same way: `cargo build -p jackioh-wasm --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features preview 2>/tmp/normal-wasm-build.log; grep -i 'signature mismatch' /tmp/normal-wasm-build.log; grep -ac 'signature_mismatch:' target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/jackioh_wasm.wasm`. Record both findings in the commit/PR description; either way steps 3–4 stand (parity forces the joint rename).
2. Add the regression gate first (red). In `scripts/build-wasm.sh`, in the `JACKIOH_WASM_C=1` block after the node import check and before the final `echo`, add a comment citing #4273 and: `if grep -aq 'signature_mismatch:' "$C_MODULE"; then echo "build-wasm: the C module contains a signature_mismatch stub (a #[no_mangle] export colliding with a libm/host symbol); rename the export" >&2; exit 1; fi`. Check syntax with `sh -n scripts/build-wasm.sh`, then run `JACKIOH_WASM_C=1 JACKIOH_WASM_NORMAL=0 sh scripts/build-wasm.sh` and confirm it now fails on the unrenamed tree. (Red proves the check catches the old code.)
3. Rename the Rust exports. In `crates/wasm/c/src/lib.rs`, rename `pub extern "C" fn log(call_json_ptr …` to `game_log` and its `arg("log: the call", …)` label to `"game_log: the call"`. In `crates/wasm/src/lib.rs`, rename `pub fn log(call_json: &str)` to `game_log`. Leave `crates/wasm/core/src/lib.rs::log` exactly as is. In `crates/wasm/c/src/tests.rs`, rename the test function and its two `call!(log; …)` invocations to `game_log`; keep the `wasm_core::log(…)` expectations.
4. Rename the web wrapper and its callers. In `apps/web/src/wasm/index.ts`, change `export function log(request: LogCall): LogAnswer` to `gameLog`, its body to `call("gameLog", () => parsed<LogAnswer>(normal.game_log(json(request))))` (raw bindgen exports keep snake_case, as `normal.combat_forecast` shows). In `apps/web/src/game/logLines.ts`, update the import and both call sites (`logLines`, `gapLine`). In `apps/web/src/wasm/index.test.ts`, update the one WRAPPERS entry.
5. Update the three docs: the two README binding-table rows and the two SURFACE spots listed above. Change only the binding name; leave surrounding prose (e.g. the economy row's "the `log` every row's `ref` carries") alone.
6. Rebuild green and verify the symbols. Run `JACKIOH_WASM_C=1 JACKIOH_WASM_NORMAL=0 sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`; confirm exit 0, no `signature mismatch` warning in its output, and `WebAssembly.Module.exports` of the built file lists `game_log` with no `log` export left behind. Rebuild the browser module (`sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`) and confirm its stderr has no `signature mismatch` warning either.
7. Run the checks listed under Tests, then `git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire` must be empty (the rename must not alter generated wire types).

## Tests

- New regression test (shell, red-then-green): the `signature_mismatch:` gate in `scripts/build-wasm.sh`. Red command (before step 3): `JACKIOH_WASM_C=1 JACKIOH_WASM_NORMAL=0 sh scripts/build-wasm.sh` must exit nonzero; green command (after step 5): same invocation must exit 0. No new Rust test file: a native `cargo test` links with the host toolchain and cannot reproduce a `wasm32` libm/cld link clash, so a native test would pass on the old code and prove nothing.
- Existing coverage kept and run: `cargo test -p jackioh-wasm-c game_log_export_answers_what_the_core_body_answers` (renamed; asserts the export answers what the body answers) and `cargo test -p jackioh-wasm-c ranked_export_answers_what_the_core_body_answers` (already calls `planSeason` then `rateGame` for two sides and asserts `STATUS_OK`; afterwards also exercise that same `rateGame` JSON through the real built `.wasm` only if step 1 showed a host capable of it — otherwise the green build plus the native assertion is the evidence).
- Parity: `cargo test -p jackioh-wasm --test export_parity` (must stay green with both sides renamed; needs no edit since it reads the sources).
- Web: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/wasm/index.test.ts` and `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/Log.test.tsx` (pretest rebuilds the WASM module the tests load).
- Style and gates: `cargo fmt --check`; `cargo clippy -p jackioh-wasm -p jackioh-wasm-c -p jackioh-wasm-core --all-targets -- -D warnings`; `cargo jackioh catalog check`; `cargo jackioh patches check`; `cargo jackioh spec check` (no ruling added; must stay green).

## Done when

- The C-module build prints no `signature mismatch` warning and its module contains no `signature_mismatch:` name.
- `game_log` is exported by both modules, `log` by neither, and the parity test passes.
- `ranked` `rateGame` answers status 0 through the C boundary (native renamed-path test green; built module green).
- The new build gate is proven red on the old code (step 2 run) and green after the rename.
- Every test and check under Tests passes, and `apps/web/src/wire/` is clean.

## Risks

- wasm-bindgen name mapping: if the generated glue for `game_log` is not exactly `game_log`, step 6's exports listing catches it; fix `index.ts` to whatever the listing shows and say so. Evidence says snake_case is preserved (`normal.combat_forecast`).
- External host breakage: any out-of-tree host (the Roblox port in #2898) calling the C `log` export must switch to `game_log`; note it in the PR description since it cannot be changed here.
- `grep -a` on the `.wasm`: binary-safe by flag; if a toolchain ever compresses or strips the name section, the check could go blind — the unmodified linker-warning line in the build log remains as the secondary signal (Done-when checks both).
- No behavior change is intended: `wasm_core` bodies, JSON shapes, log line text, and Glicko-2 math are untouched, so golden replays and fuzz hashes are unaffected; the full `cargo test --workspace` and fuzz runs stay with CI.

## Open questions

None.
```
